initial_finding: The pinned 1780 TIFF uses an embedded ICC color space. Direct LosslessFactory embedding preserves profile bytes, but rendered RGB differs from Java ImageIO getRGB. Initial reports retain false source_render_rgb_equal and are not pixel-identity baselines.
correction: Copy each decoded opaque getRGB row into TYPE_INT_RGB before lossless embedding. This freezes the same independently decoded RGB pixel values used by source hashing, avoiding a second profile interpretation. No crop, scaling, binarization, contrast enhancement or OCR-output-dependent change. Assert source/render RGB equality on successful recognition. Owned controls cover RGB, grayscale and packed RGB.
ordering: Both new references omit line reading order. Preserve XML order, retain geometry associations and label whole-sequence edits xml_sequence_*. No validated logical-page CER/WER.
corpus_limits: Two prospectively selected pages with source condition labels, unknown model training overlap and no held-out acceptance claim.
